mapper.select: SELECT assignment.id AS assignment_id, assignment.result, assignment.assign_date, category.category_name, assignment.target_value, CASE WHEN mission.mission_type = 'ABSOLUTE' THEN 50 ELSE difficulty.score END AS base_points, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_mission_info previous_assignment WHERE previous_assignment.user_id = assignment.user_id AND previous_assignment.assign_date = DATE_SUB(assignment.assign_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND previous_assignment.result = 'SUCCESS' ) AS previous_success, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN mission_transaction.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(mission_transaction.refunded_amount, mission_transaction.amount) ELSE mission_transaction.amount END ), 0) AS current_amount FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment JOIN tbl_mission_pool mission ON mission.id = assignment.mission_id LEFT JOIN tbl_category category ON category.id = mission.category_id LEFT JOIN tbl_mission_difficulty difficulty ON difficulty.id = assignment.difficulty_id LEFT JOIN tbl_transaction mission_transaction ON mission_transaction.user_id = assignment.user_id AND mission_transaction.category_id = mission.category_id AND mission_transaction.tr_date = assignment.assign_date AND mission_transaction.classification = 'CONSUMPTION' AND mission_transaction.direction = 'OUT' AND mission_transaction.is_excluded_from_summary = 0 WHERE GROUP BY assignment.id, assignment.user_id, assignment.result, assignment.assign_date, category.category_name, assignment.target_value, mission.mission_type, difficulty.score LIMIT 1

SELECT mission_transaction.id AS transaction_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(mission_transaction.merchant_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(mission_transaction.description1), ''), '거래') AS merchant_name, CASE WHEN mission_transaction.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(mission_transaction.refunded_amount, mission_transaction.amount) ELSE mission_transaction.amount END AS amount FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment JOIN tbl_mission_pool mission ON mission.id = assignment.mission_id JOIN tbl_transaction mission_transaction ON mission_transaction.user_id = assignment.user_id AND mission_transaction.category_id = mission.category_id AND mission_transaction.tr_date = assignment.assign_date AND mission_transaction.classification = 'CONSUMPTION' AND mission_transaction.direction = 'OUT' AND mission_transaction.is_excluded_from_summary = 0 WHERE assignment.id = #{assignmentId} AND assignment.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY mission_transaction.tr_time, mission_transaction.id
SELECT assign_date AS date, result FROM tbl_user_mission_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND assign_date <= #{endDate} AND result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') ORDER BY assign_date DESC
